description: On the table in front of you is a small white plastic stool-like model with upright pieces, and a separate white blocky part off to the right. The left hand steadies the round base while the right hand moves in to grasp one upright section, twists and pulls to detach a block-like piece from the model, briefly lifts it away, then releases it onto the tabletop and leaves the remaining upright piece standing on the base.
